newsitem.title: JAPAN: Chubu Electric puts two thermal generators on line.
newsitem.headline: Chubu Electric puts two thermal generators on line.

text.p: Chubu Electric Power Co Inc said on Monday two thermal generators, which run on liquefied natural gas (LNG), have started commercial operations at its Kawagoe plant in central Japan's Mie Prefecture.
The generators, with an output capacity of 243,000 kilowatt (kw) each, have brought the total capacity of the Kawagoe plant to 3.05 million kw.
The utility has a term contract with Qatar Liquefied Gas Co to buy up to four million tonnes of LNG per year for 25 years starting in 1997.
The first LNG cargo from Qatar is expected to arrive at Kawagoe early next year, a Chubu spokeswoman said.
Chubu will buy two million tonnes in 1997 under the term contract, she added.
